text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"Hello to everyone watching our broadcast!
Happy New Year!
It's time for Twinkle Lovers!"

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: "Today, on New Year's Day, we're asking passionate race fans who just can't get enough racing about their expectations for the racing world this year!"

text_block_list.name: Man (30s)
text_block_list.text:
"—I just can't take my eyes off Almond Eye!
I'm so ridiculously excited to see how she does!"

text_block_list.name: Man (30s)
text_block_list.text:
"Becoming only the second Umamusume in history after Gentildonna
to be selected as Horse of the Year as a Classic-year Tiara Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Man (30s)
text_block_list.text:
"What's more, a unanimous vote hasn't happened since the 'Overlord' T.M. Opera O!
That is just how shocking her Japan Cup was...!"

text_block_list.name: Man (30s)
text_block_list.text: "Considering Gentildonna's later successes, Almond Eye is bound to achieve just as much as that grande dame...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Well, of course it is. I only just entered the Senior Class, you know?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Just being compared to someone who's already achieved so much is incredible on its own!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...So you're saying you think
everyone ought to expect far, far more from me?"

The praise around her is already high. However, it remains at the usual level of excitement;
they likely don't realize she is truly legendary just yet.

How deeply she remains in people's hearts is what matters.
For it is they who will pass down the greatness of Almond Eye to future generations.
choice_data_list: (I'll have to build it up step by step over a whole year!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then we've gotta do our best for today's event too.
Alright, I'm gonna throw out a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Bring the mochi!

As one of this year's most promising Umamusume,
Almond Eye was invited to the annual mochi-throwing event,
which gathers popular figures every year. There—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ai-san, I'm looking forward to working with you today!
Kitasan Black—she, too, is one of the legendary Umamusume with seven turf GⅠ victories.

Just as Almond Eye was rising to prominence,
she stepped back from the front lines. Lately,
she's become a widely sought-after popular figure on TV.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Same here, Kita-chan!
As my senior in mochi tossing, teach me everything you know!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Ever since I was little, I've tossed all kinds of stuff at neighborhood festivals...
I'll pass that power on to Ai-san!
choice_data_list: (What on earth did she scatter around...?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Tons and tons of Ai-san's fans
have packed the venue today, after all!

text_block_list.name: Ai's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I can't wait♡
I wonder if I can get some of Ai-chan's mochi?

text_block_list.name: Ai's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I've only ever seen her from afar, but I bet she's insanely cute in person too~♪
Strong AND cute? Talk about total goals~!
choice_data_list: (The crowd really is fired up, huh……)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "To come all the way out here despite this freezing cold... The love of our fans is something to truly be grateful for."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Kita-chan...
You're "everyone's beloved horse girl"—aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I love hearing you say that!
It really warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't always like this, you know.
Only after getting results did people gradually start placing their hopes on me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Your cheers, your expectations... Everything I get
from everyone—is my greatest joy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye-san is right in the middle
of feeling that herself right now, isn't she!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I appreciate the cheers,
and it makes me happy to see people celebrate my victory!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's not my greatest joy.
Winning—that's what's number one!

Being able to give your all for those who support you—
that strength of Kitasan Black's
was ultimately not the kind of strength Almond Eye possessed.

And with that,
while talking with Kitasan Black, the event time arrived—

text_block_list.name: Ai & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Wasshoi!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"‘So high!’ ‘Center, fall back more!’
‘Guh... Kitasan's mochi is so heavy...!’
‘Watch out, Ai-chan's mochi is curving!’"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~, that was fun! Though near the end,
I ended up getting a little too fired up...
choice_data_list: You really threw it way far out, after all.
You really threw it way far out, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Because I want to give some to the people in the back too! But I still need to get a better feel for the distance—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh? That ema plaque over there is...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"May Ai-chan safely finish
all her races this year as well"...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, thank you.
"She doesn't run just for that. But Almond Eye will always keep someone's wishes close to her heart—"

"At that moment, I suddenly remembered
a certain saying."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I guess people sometimes put it that way.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
What about it?

If that's the reason—if someone's wish makes an Umamusume stronger, allowing them to fulfill each other's dreams...
Then racing truly feels like a precious, dearly cherished endeavor.
choice_data_list: ...I just thought it looked lovely, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heeey!
Eye-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Blast and—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lala!
You were here too!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Blast-san invited me, y'see.
I heard they're holdin' a New Year's event
all around this area?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, aren't you free now?
Boo, Ai and Lara wanna play with Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I wanna play too!
Trainer, what kind of events were there again?
choice_data_list: Focusing the mind with a Kyudo experience.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ooh~~! Not scattering them, but pounding them squish-squish!
choice_data_list: There are three of us, so how should we pair up?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Of course I—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! We're gonna make our mochi
way chewier and faster than Lala and Blast!

And to make matters worse, I was the turner—
the one responsible for flipping the mochi.
If her mallet were to hit my hand by mistake...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
—It's alright, believe in me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Here we go, Trainer!
Ready, set... Hup! Hup! Hup!”

Focusing every nerve on Almond Eye's breathing,
I matched her movements and kept turning the mochi
at my absolute maximum speed—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...!
Now this is what you call perfect synchronicity...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's enough!
Trainer, it's gotten super soft and chewy!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's so chewy and soft...! (Phew)
Yeah, it's so nice and chewy...! (Phew)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: By the way, what about Lala and the others—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry, Lala.
Boo misjudged... how much strength to use.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine, really... Luckily, only the mallet broke.
We can just go get some mochi from Ai-san's place, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —It's getting late. Shall we head back to the academy?
It seems they've rented out a nearby shop and set up a corner where people can enjoy custom mochi recipes.
choice_data_list: Let's eat what we got from the mochi toss

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I'm getting a little peckish too...
Let's have a snack!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da!
Boo's special arrangement: the "Mochi Tower"!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Look, I stacked up a whole buuunch of mochi!
It's gonna be super filling!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's a crazy height, eh.
Callin' it an arrangement's an understatement... it's straight-up architecture.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Look!
This one is "Chubby Mochi"!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"There's smooth red bean paste inside.
I wanted a cute silhouette, so I modeled it after the ridges of a seashell!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……Ai-san, is that……—
……Never mind, it looks quite lovely.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right?
I just love this plump, rounded feel♪
choice_data_list: (No matter how you look at it, that's a 'steamed meat bun'...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —It's getting late. Shall we head back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh...! Kyudo,
how nostalgic!
choice_data_list: Have you ever done this before?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I used to take lessons when I was little!
For Umamusume, it's pretty much a classic after-school activity, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right ya are, I used to take lessons too.
Which means... we're both experienced, eh?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
In that case... wanna have a contest?
To see who can hit the target the most.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...No!
Let's see who can shoot down the most stars instead!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...That's just like you, Almond Eye-san.
Well then... shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Ai & Lala
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...!
Ai and Rara both hit the target so well!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, aren't you going to do it?
Come to think of it, aren't you going to do it?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Boo wants to watch for a bit first!
Because—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you two together like this,
I just kinda love it~♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —It's getting late. Shall we head back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo is gonna stop by the outdoor gym!
They've got equipment that fits Boo just right♪"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Ai!
Bu is—entering the Osaka Hai!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Finally, I can take on Ai head-on at my absolute best!
I've been waiting for this moment forever!

Blast Onepiece has definitely
been improving her form lately.
Earlier this year, alongside Almond Eye, who won Best Classic-Class Queen Umamusume, she was named Best Classic-Class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I'll challenge my beloved Ai with everything this Bu has!
Look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...We're roommates, after all.
I've known how strong you are all along."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If you're coming at me with everything you've got—
then I'll respond with everything I have too!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Ah, as for me... my immediate primary goal
is set on the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "The Victoria Mile is the spring pinnacle of the Senior Tiara route... I want to make my mark there."
choice_data_list: I see, so you're taking the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Don't worry about me. More importantly—
I heard Kiseki-san will be running in the Osaka Hai, too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Hmm, hmmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A plot twist where we beat Ai-chan...
I can't think of one at aaaaall!
Kiseki is in big trouble!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There has to be a clue somewhere!
Don't stop thinking, get the blood pumping to your brain—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――...Inspiration, strike meeee!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Even right now, I bet they're still
burning with the desire to beat Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Let's train together too!

Almond Eye has immediately become the target
all her rivals are aiming for.
—Looks like we're in for some thrilling races this year.
